title: KitchenTour Dual Platform Digital Kitchen Scale with Total Weight Function - 500g/0.01g & 15kg/1g - Accurate for Cooking and Baking -Ideal for Meal Prep and Portion Control
description:
About this item
【High Precision Dual Scale】Upgrade your cooking with our Dual Platform Kitchen Scale. The larger platform measures up to 15,000g in 1g increments, while the small one handles up to 500g in precise 0.01g steps—ideal for baking and expert coffee brewing.
【Intelligent Accumulation Function】Simplify complex recipes with our intuitive accumulation feature, combining weights from both platforms. Achieve precise results for any dish. The bright, backlit LCD delivers clear, accurate readings, even in dim light.
【Versatile Functions】Switch with ease between 7 units (g, kg, lb, oz,lb:oz, ml, milk ml). The tare function easily zeroes out container weight, and auto shut-off saves battery life. Ideal for daily meal prep or weighing delicate items like jewelry.
【Easy to Clean & Durable】Built with sleek stainless steel and break-resistant glass, our scale is both stylish and hygienic. The rust-proof surface wipes clean effortlessly, keeping your kitchen pristine while offering lasting durability for everyday use.
【Compact & Space-Saving Design】Maximize your kitchen space. The 6.9 x 6.8 inches large platform handles mixing bowls, while the 2.7 x 2.7 inches small platform suits fine measurements. Ideal for both home cooks and professional chefs in tight kitchens.
reviews_5s:
Nice looking scale and it seems to be very accurate. Easy set up an operation.I love this scale. It is worth the money in gold. I have a hard time when it comes to gms in salt being a small amount now I can weigh with accuracy.Great productsThis kitchen scale is fantastic and replaces using two scales or having to do math as I weigh the heavier ingredients (such as flour) and the light ones (like salt or baking powder).

I compared both of the scales on this unit to my other kitchen scales and the accuracy seemed to be as good or better.

The plastic cover for placing over the smaller, precision scale helps protect it from bumps or damage.

This saves me time when baking and that's always a good thing!This dual platform kitchen scale works really well and it's very easy to use, there are 2 seperate scales on the base, a large scale that can measure weights from 0.01g up to 500g and a smaller scale that can measure weight from 1g up to 15kg, both scales are very accurate, the base also has a good size backlit LCD display screen, the display screen is a split screen so it will show the weights from both scales at the same time, the touch buttons below the display screen have the power button, a tare button for each scale, an = button and the units button, the scales have several units of weight they can measure like, ounces, ounces & pounds, grams, kilograms ect, the scale also has a built-in rechargeable battery with a pretty long battery life and it has an auto shut off feature as well, all in all I am very happy with the quality and accuracy of the dual kitchen scale, definitely worth the price in my opinion.So, I'm actually using this in my pottery studio and it's great! I like that I can use both scales at once to weigh out clay and stains together. The display is bright and clear to read. I do wish that you were able to change the unit of measurement individually for each scale, rather than them both having to be the same, but it's not that big of a deal. The metal surface of the scale has scratched fairly easily, but also not that big of a deal for me and my use.I love that this has dual scales because of how often I am wanting to weigh separate items before adding or making 2 things at once. The display is super easy to read and zero out bowls during prep. It is easy to wipe clean and I compared to another scale that I have used for years - and the measurements are exact. This is a really good addition to my meal prep and I think would make a good gift for someone as well.My first impression upon opening the box was how well-made and just plain good-looking this scale is. It's heavy, in a good-and-sturdy way, and it's larger than my old scale, which was something I was looking for. Previously, I was limited in the size of the object I could weigh or the bowl/plate I weighed them on because my old scale was tiny, but this guy is much larger. It can handle a wide array of shapes, sizes, and containers while still allowing you to see the display.

The "tiny" second scale is SENSITIVE! If you turn it on and blow on the platform you'll see the weight change just because of the force of wind from you blowing. So far I can't speak to the accuracy of the scale on a super-tight level, but weighing things like 16oz of water and other known weights give me about the right reading, but what I'm weighing are common household items, not calibration weights so those things will have a large variance in their weights, often even between identical items.

In short, love it and I'm so glad I got it!If you’re not familiar with scales, make sure to use foil or saran wrap when weighing your food. You don’t want any liquid dripping all over it. 😉
The last scale I had was about the size of the palm of my hand so I could only measure strips of steak or salmon. This scale is almost 11 inches wide with a pan width of about 7 inches. It is bigger than I was expecting, but I love that this scale can measure with a bowl sitting on it.

There is a smaller pan but I haven't found a need for it, yet. I did make sure to test the weight of the same items on both pans and the weight is exactly correct.

Do keep in mind this requires batteries and is not rechargeable, but it is accurate and so helpful for food prepping. The display is bold and not so bright that it hurts your eyes. I only weigh in pounds and ounces, but you can do grams and kgs, too.

The only thing I think is missing is a storage bag. I don’t have a lot of room on my counters because I live in a small space, so I just wrapped it in a tea towel to put it in the drawer. I will find a way to store it better, eventually. Overall, I would recommend it. It's well made and working perfectly for me.So far so good. I've used this several times and it is still holding its accuracy. I like the small side scale for when I am weighing smaller amounts. I will update if there are any future issues.
reviews_1s:
I would love to give this scale a great review because it has all the features l want. However, it keeps shutting off mid-weigh. I'm trying to lose a few pounds & that factor is so annoying! It times out unless I restart it each time I weigh something. So, if I'm trying to weigh 4 things, unless I shut it off 4 times, I risk putting something on the plate that I don't get an accurate read on. >:(With some items this scale is fairly consistent between readings. Other times it’s just whackadoodle. I read the directions carefully and tested this thing extensively. One of the highlights is when I weighed a cellophane bag of spaghetti. In the bag it said 900 grams. The first time I weighed the spaghetti I got a reading of 533 grams. I tried it again after weighing a number of other items. I got 531 grams. I weighed many more items and tested it again: 505 grams. I wasn’t nibbling on it, honest. Later it weighed 546 grams and finally 520 grams. I deliberately did my testing on a very solid, heavy flat table at the post office. I was going to compare the weights of everything, but I lost enthusiasm after the spaghetti on that scale came in at very slightly over 900 grams. I even had someone else weigh it on their scale later on. Same reading.

Now this is where I really had to say to golly gosh heck with it! I weighed 3 cases of soft drinks and two big jugs of cooking oil. The scale said 14,255 grams. You’ll never guess what happened when I put the spaghetti on as well: it weighed 378 grams LESS.

The scale sucks. Case closed.
